summary: Session 12 — 'Home Layout Manager' feature verified end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 7/7 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_home_layout.py — (a) GET /api/home returns sections including 'recommended' (type 'recommended', title 'Made for You'), 'pick_week' (type 'pick_week', title 'Pick of the Week') and 'recently_added' (type 'albums', title 'Recently Added'); (b) GET /api/admin/home-layout is auth-gated (returns 401/403 without token) and returns {rows:[{id,title,enabled}]} with admin token; (c) PUT /api/admin/home-layout with a custom rows array persists — GET /api/home then reflects the config: disabled rows ('trending','new') are OMITTED and enabled rows are ordered exactly as saved (pick_week → recommended → recently_added). Cleanup test resets home_layout to all-enabled default (canonical order), so demo home is not left with hidden rows. Frontend (mobile 390x844 web preview): (1) Consumer '/' home renders all 3 new rows visibly — 'Made for You' with 8 home-rec-<song_id> cards, 'Pick of the Week' with 5 home-pick-<album_id> cards, 'Recently Added' as album cards. Tapping home-pick-alb_a4afca836a0b routes to /album/alb_a4afca836a0b as required. (2) Admin gate flow works: /admin shows 'Ingia kama Admin' → tapping goes to (auth)/login, filling testIDs login-email/login-password + login-submit logs in, navigating back to /admin loads the dashboard. (3) Sidebar 'Control & Management' group (nav-group-control) expands and its 'Layout Management' leaf (nav-layout-management) opens the NEW LayoutManager component — NOT a 'coming soon' toast. Screen renders 'Layout Management' title + 'Reorder and show/hide the rows on the app home screen.' subtitle, all 6 rows with testIDs layout-toggle-{id}, layout-up-{id}, layout-down-{id}, plus layout-save button. Tapping Save fires PUT /api/admin/home-layout and shows toast 'Home layout saved'. No red screen, no crash. Console only warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (RN Web internal). 401 console noise is expected pre-auth admin API probes.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/admin/index.tsx is still 1105+ lines (already flagged in iter_13/14/15). Extract per-tab renderers to keep under the 700-line soft limit. Non-blocking.

/app/backend/routers/home.py duplicates album+song enrichment logic between the default (`new`), category rails and the new (`recently_added`) sections — songs_count is re-computed in three places. Consider a helper `enrich_albums(albums)` to DRY it up.

/app/frontend/src/components/admin/LayoutManager.tsx: the up/down chevron color uses `C.border` for the disabled state (first row up / last row down) which is nearly invisible against C.cardAlt on the mobile theme. Consider `C.muted` instead so it reads as 'disabled' rather than 'hidden'. Not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — consumer 3 rows + admin Layout Manager verified
